integrity: The accompanying checker reproduces exact finite-rank moments and approximate algebraic roots; the infinite family follows from the displayed exact factorial-moment and derivative argument, not finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Sharp theorem concerns exactly two real irreducible central characters of S_n, n at least four, under probability-normalized counting measure.
Not a theorem about all matrix coefficients in the isotypic blocks or Fourier-projection norms.
The cycle-factorial moment identity and character polynomial representations predate this theorem.
Historical priority of the exact combined optimization is not independently certified.
title: Sharp fourth moments for the first two nontrivial symmetric-group characters
